incident-bot: ALERT: notify-gateway failed to ACK outbound pages to PagerFlow for ~22m — suppressing auto-pages. svc=notify-gateway severity=high trace_id=tx-9f2b

marta: getting multiple support pings, customers saying pages didn't go out. any live impact? :eyes:
ajay: pagerflow logs show repeated 502 from notify-gateway POST /v1/pagers; ack header truncated, downstream returned 400. sample: `POST /v1/pagers -> 502, body size=0`
sophia: jumping in. looks like header trimming in our edge proxy after the last deploy. rolling fallback to secondary webhook target now.
ajay: executing runbook step: `/runbook reroute notify-gateway -> notify-gateway-secondary`
incident-bot: Runbook: reroute target updated, traffic now 100% -> notify-gateway-secondary. Rollback token TTL = 30m.
marta: manually triggered SMS fallback for the five customers on the critical list (ACME, BlueCore, DemoInc). CS notified.
oncall-sre: @marta @sophia thanks — can you confirm how many on-call pages were missed during the window? We need PagerDuty reconciliation.
ajay: quick tally from pivot: ~18 pages attempted, 5 failed deliveries to primary route (acked by gateway but not forwarded). PD shows 5 no-ack.
cs-lead: CS has opened tickets and emailed customers; we flagged as P1 impact for those accounts. ETA to full fix?
sophia: patch is small — proxy was trimming `X-Pager-Ack` when body=0. patch: ```diff
- header = header[:1024]
+ header = header if header else ''
+ # ensure ack header preserved even with empty bodies
```

sophia: deploying hotpatch to notify-gateway now (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Monitoring metrics.
marta: monitoring PD & support for reattempts. If we see >3 failed pages after rollback window, escalate to execs.
oncall-sre: good mitigation. I'm staying on call for 45m. Please post when canary hits 100%.
incident-bot: Canary at 10% -> healthy.
sophia: canary 50% -> healthy. No error spikes.
sophia: canary 100% -> healthy. header trimming fixed in prod.
marta: re-running reconcile script to mark missed pages and trigger manual re-pages where necessary.
ajay: reconcile summary: 5 manual re-pages sent, 0 additional failures.
cs-lead: customers updated, impact window documented. recommending incident P1 -> mitigated, follow-up RCA.
marta: closing live triage. follow-up owner: @ajay for RCA, @sophia for deploy hardening. Let's sync in retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> paging route fallback removed, monitor until 2023-12-02T14:15:00Z.
